question.prompt: What are the distances from the point \(P(-3,4)\) to the x-axis and the y-axis, respectively? (Separate your answers with a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The distance to the x-axis is the absolute value of the y-coordinate, \(|4|=4\). The distance to the y-axis is the absolute value of the x-coordinate, \(|-3|=3\).
solutions.title: Distances from coordinate values
